GOV-F-003-S73.title: Brain Lock Schema and Contract Definition
GOV-F-003-S73.description: Define and implement the MongoDB schema for Brain locks including fields for lock_id, owner_id, acquired_at, expires_at (TTL), and status. Ensure TTL index is configured and contract is enforced across all lock reads/writes.

GOV-F-003-S74.title: Lock Acquisition and Renewal API
GOV-F-003-S74.description: Implement backend functions for acquiring, renewing, and releasing Brain locks with strict ownership validation and TTL extension support. Ensure atomic operations to prevent concurrent acquisition.

GOV-F-003-S75.title: Brain Runner Integration with Lock Lifecycle
GOV-F-003-S75.description: Integrate lock acquisition, renewal, and release into brain_runner and brain_loop execution paths to ensure all assignments are protected by lock ownership and TTL enforcement.

GOV-F-003-S76.title: Observability and Debug Logging for Lock State
GOV-F-003-S76.description: Extend debug_logger to capture lock lifecycle events (acquire, renew, expire, recover, release) with ownership and timing metadata for auditability and troubleshooting.
